project 1.title: PHP Backend for IoT device
project 1.description: During my third year at HVA, I was given the assignment to develop a backend for an Internet of things device, this included basic CRUD operations through a REST API.

coreActivities.1: Developing backend structure through OOP principles.
coreActivities.2: Designing and implementing a SQL database that is normalized to a minimum of N3.
coreActivities.3: Working with Docker containers and altering these where needed.

project 2.title: Fullstack application for an AI teacher assistant
project 2.description: During the studio smart cities, we had to create an  AI teacher tool that generates excersises for gifted students, with the core idea being that there is a human in the loop when the model generates excersises

coreActivities.2: Designing and implementing a a postgress database
coreActivities.4: Creating a dashboard for teachers to get insights into statistics generate from the application

project 3.title: Fullstack application for displaying election data
project 3.description: During the second year of my study we were tasked with writing an efficient XML parser in java to visualize election data through a web app.

coreActivities.2: Creating a search functionality for candidates
coreActivities.4: Creating a login/registry functionality with spring security
